question: Do Sodium + Chloride + Cubes Without Borders crash on the genuine NeoForge client, with no Forbric involved?
loader: NeoForge 26.2.0.88 (FML 11.0.16), official installer output, main class net.neoforged.fml.startup.Client, no javaagent, no Forbric jar on the classpath; Java 25.0.3
inputs: the same jars as reports/2026-10-03-sweep100-rerun (sha1 equal to mixed-manifest.json); fresh game directory per run
verdictRule: TITLE = no crash report, TitleScreen instance >= 1 and LoadingOverlay = 0 in two class histograms 20 s apart, and a window screenshot of the title menu; CRASH = a crash report

runs.description: Description: Failed to build config options

answer: Yes. Run 1 crashes with the same first line as the Forbric run: IllegalArgumentException: Multiple overrides for option 'sodium:general.fullscreen_mode'! Sources: chloride and cwb, from Sodium's Config.applyOptionChanges during the first resource reload. Sodium with either mod alone reaches the title screen.
notScope: Only NeoForge: chloride ships only a NeoForge build, so the pair cannot be assembled on Fabric or MinecraftForge.
